meaning: Compose the seven qualified cross-generator verification families over one registered graph and reconciled project plan without dropping roots, modules, repeated import occurrences or unavailable semantic families.
inputs: Original registered graph and matching plan only. Definitions come from a separate pinned compiled source capsule. No caller-selected contract bytes, observations, callbacks, family filters or replacement control rows.
preparation: Create every family from the same complete static boundary with its exact existing definition and full finite controls. Keep all rows, including not_evaluable and inapplicable. Preparation is source-derived selection, never execution evidence. Invalid graph/plan or definition bindings reject; family-local construction failures remain named fail diagnostics while independent families are collected.
incidence: Retain the entire boundary requests, modules, edges and roots in source order. Each edge has a stable occurrence identity and category. Generated runtime edges, generated type-only edges and native standard library dependencies remain distinct. Map each ready row only to its existing exact protocol edge identities; Operation and Workflow wrapper identity evidence is separately labeled. A transitive module being present does not prove its call protocol.
coverage: Rows and edge witnesses are obligations, not results. Zero-edge roots stay visible. Missing protocols and unavailable families remain explicit. Runtime behavior is required for cross-generator-kind generated-runtime edges; same-kind, type-only and standard-library incidence remains visible and is separately verified by its owning semantic/native checks.
execution: Following integration must execute every ready family with the qualified retained executor, compare the whole finite family, and retain all audit and identity evidence. Factory/owned/producer surfaces remain separate. Workflow uses original ESM, all batches and all six audits; no prefix or substitute example. Expected outcomes never enter native observer inputs.
currentness: Before final public aggregation and owned workspace cleanup, recheck every retained receipt and the original source/plan and public native evidence dependencies. Failures dominate; otherwise missing required family or edge evidence yields incomplete, never pass. Report rendering after cleanup is sealed historical evidence, not a claim retained files still exist.
public_join: Public cross-generator behavior can pass only after actual retained observations and all current public compilation/audit prerequisites pass. This definition supplements the existing executor contract; it does not authorize production effects or label static preparation as runtime verification.
effects: Preparation is read-only and requires no development-tree file access at runtime. Eventual native verification writes only owned private run workspaces with bounded fixture ports; never production providers, policy targets, compensation execution, tools installation, user output targets, source mutation, publication or default cutover.
compatibility: Preserve the original 70-source compiler capsule, original generated code, existing family limits and private CommonJS executor. Packaging a successor contract bundle is not a release or admission.
